idx_audit_entries_network_scrub.name: idx_audit_entries_network_scrub
idx_audit_entries_network_scrub.where: "audit_entries"."ip_address" IS NOT NULL OR "audit_entries"."user_agent" IS NOT NULL

auth_throttle_ip_community_check.name: auth_throttle_ip_community_check
auth_throttle_ip_community_check.value: ("auth_throttle"."kind" = 'account') OR ("auth_throttle"."kind" = 'ip' AND "auth_throttle"."community_id" IS NULL) OR ("auth_throttle"."kind" = 'claim' AND "auth_throttle"."community_id" IS NOT NULL)

login_codes_purpose_expiry_check.name: login_codes_purpose_expiry_check
login_codes_purpose_expiry_check.value: ("login_codes"."purpose" = 'admin_issued' AND "login_codes"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("login_codes"."purpose" = 'recovery' AND "login_codes"."expires_at" IS NULL)

claim_tokens_consumed_check.name: claim_tokens_consumed_check
claim_tokens_consumed_check.value: ("claim_tokens"."consumed_by" IS NULL) OR ("claim_tokens"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)

import_manifests_committed_at_check.name: import_manifests_committed_at_check
import_manifests_committed_at_check.value: ("import_manifests"."status" = 'committed' AND "import_manifests"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("import_manifests"."status" <> 'committed' AND "import_manifests"."committed_at" IS NULL)

community_sovereignty_requests_cancelled.name: community_sovereignty_requests_cancelled_check
community_sovereignty_requests_cancelled.value: ("community_sovereignty_requests"."state" = 'cancelled' AND "community_sovereignty_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("community_sovereignty_requests"."state" <> 'cancelled' AND "community_sovereignty_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

community_sovereignty_requests_completed.name: community_sovereignty_requests_completed_check
community_sovereignty_requests_completed.value: ("community_sovereignty_requests"."state" = 'completed' AND "community_sovereignty_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("community_sovereignty_requests"."state" <> 'completed' AND "community_sovereignty_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL)

community_archive_custody_destroyed_chec.name: community_archive_custody_destroyed_check
community_archive_custody_destroyed_chec.value: ("community_archive_custody"."status" = 'destroyed' AND "community_archive_custody"."destroyed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("community_archive_custody"."status" = 'held' AND "community_archive_custody"."destroyed_at" IS NULL)
